Silk as armor goes way back to the BC era. it was one of the few things that could stop arrows but was extremely expensive. Silk was discovered to also be able to stop a bullet sometime in the mid to late 1800's (1850-1880) by a doctor who noticed that some gun shot victims had their silk handkerchief pulled into the wound by the ball but not actually break. Silk body armor was used by some law enforcement agencies in the 1920s. It wasnt until DuPont went looking for a synthetic to silk that they discovered nylon. it wasnt until someone later realized that you could weave that nylon tight enough and stack it to create bullet resisting properties. Because silk was always so expensive silk body armor was never widely used or known about. and after science made a replacement for it people forgot all about it.
